title: Stratford-Perth Museum

services.name: Tours / Groups
services.desc: The Stratford Perth Museum has many exciting programs for school groups. Choose from a variety of exciting curriculum-connected in-classroom or remote learning programs. It is our mission to deliver local history in fun, creative and safe ways. Our Education & Programs department fuses academic learning with captivating content that inspires intrigue, wonder, and engagement. Ranging from Hands On Workshops to Justin Bieber VIP Tours, our compelling ‘edutainment’ formula appeals to diverse demographics drawing both tourists and routine visitors. Educators are invited to select 2-4 stations from the list below related to their curriculum or interest. Guests are split into groups upon arrival

services.name: Past Exhibits
services.desc: To Thine Own Self: Stratford Trashion Week Edition is a textile and audio exhibit that looks at celebrating and exploring individuality and gender inclusivity presented at local event, Stratford Trashion Week, and on the Stratford Festival Stages. The exhibit features Stratford Trashion Week wearable art pieces and Stratford Festival photos and stories from local productions that made history through innovative, non-traditional presentations of gender that earned both accolades and raised eyebrows. Stratford Trashion Week, started in 2018, is held every two years during Earth Week. This event brings together designers, artists, and creatives to transform discarded and repurposed materials
